source_note: Keeper Rulebook Chapter 9: Magic (pp.176-179 mechanics) + Chapter 12: Grimoire (pp.242-265 spell descriptions). First casting uses Hard POW; book/person learning uses Hard INT, entity teaching uses INT; failed pushed casting still works with multiplied costs and source consequences.

minor.effect: Disembodied screaming, voices, or other noises.
Strong winds or other atmospheric effects.
Bleeding—from the caster, others present, or the environment.
Small animals in the vicinity explode.

major.effect: The caster's hand is withered and burnt.
The caster ages unnaturally (+2D10 years and characteristic modifiers).
Powerful or numerous Mythos entities appear, attacking all nearby starting with the caster.
The caster or everyone nearby is sucked to a distant time or place.
